# QRay Comprehensive Empirical Testing Report
## Auto-generated by `python backend/run_empirical.py --all --doc`

> **Evaluation Methodology & Terminology Note:**
> 1. **Quantum-Inspired Heuristics**: Algorithms labeled *Quantum-Inspired* (Q-ALNS+, QPSO, QGA, QACO, QASA, QSS) run on standard classical CPU hardware, utilizing mathematical formulations inspired by quantum physics (Lorentzian tunneling, Born rule sampling, and rotation gates) rather than physical QPUs.
> 2. **Benchmark Conditions**: Results are recorded under deterministic seed (`seed=42`) with fixed scale time budgets. Feasibility (✅/❌) validates vehicle capacity and split-delivery constraints.
> 3. **OR-Tools GLS Baseline**: In runtime profiling, Google OR-Tools Guided Local Search is given an extended 60.0s search budget to serve as the asymptotic quality benchmark.
